product_one_liner.value: Envoy provides workplace-management software for organizations to manage visitors, workplace resources, emergency response, mailrooms, signage, and related workplace operations.
product_one_liner.notes: Described as an all-in-one workplace management platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are listed as customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company location and LinkedIn headquarters listing.

founded_year.notes: Envoy company overview identifies 2013 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The main blog index is available, but the evidence gathered did not establish whether it includes at least two engineer-authored technical posts. The separate Builders @ Envoy page was not inspected.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal provides guides and API references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers page displayed “No jobs found” when checked.

model_provider.value: Anthropic (Claude), including via Amazon Bedrock for document parsing; AWS Rekognition is used for image-recognition features.
model_provider.notes: Company AI usage information identifies Claude/document parsing and AWS Rekognition; the subprocessor page also names Anthropic.

compliance_certs.notes: The security/legal pages name SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS. PCI DSS is described in connection with supporting customer access requirements, not as an Envoy certification; the page asserts Envoy compliance with GDPR and availability of a SOC 2 Type 2 report.

last_funding.notes: The company's January 11, 2022 press release announced a $111 million Series C.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round identified was in January 2022, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company's jobs page displayed no current job listings.

launched_6mo.notes: Dated product-release posts in August and November 2026 report Envoy Response launch and subsequent product releases.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The most recent leadership-hire announcement located was April 22, 2025, before the 12-month window; no later executive departure or appointment was established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No CRM or sales/marketing system was named on the reviewed developer portal. The careers page showed no openings, and an integrations/job-post source naming a system was not established.
